frontmatter.title: Finding the Majority Element in an Array: A Guide to Efficient Algorithms
frontmatter.subheading: Uncover the Most Frequent Element with Linear Time and Constant Space
frontmatter.excerpt: Discover how to find the majority element in an array using efficient algorithms in JavaScript. Learn two approaches: one using a hash table and the Boyer-Moore Voting Algorithm for optimal performance. Ideal for web developers looking to enhance their algorithmic skills.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
